posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Realistically, everything's limited and collectible. There will never be an infinite number of promo cards. 

I guess I just don't understand the "I want these special things I own to be exclusive to me and the few others that were lucky enough to discover said things early on" mentality. I only care what the value of something is if I want to buy or sell it. And I'd genuinely prefer for as many other people as possible to enjoy the cool stuff too!

Needless to say, I'm not a fan of Kickstarter/early adoptor/otherwise limited in some way rewards if they provide a changed play experience. Extra art, fun minis, upgraded components, merchandise, sure. But a new way to play? New characters? Seems unfair to me - unfair to people who heard about the game too late, or can't justify international shipping (since most Kickstarter projects ship from the US).

/rant
